items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Or George Johnson the tenor saxophone player didn't read very well

ctx.x: Oh, I thought you said a number of them didn't read.

Well this was in the old Wolverine band. The old Wolverines. This is 1924. And the piano player couldn't read and Bix didn't read very well. Or George Johnson the tenor saxophone player didn't read very well, hardly at all, just a little bit. And the drummer didn't read. And Bob Gillette, the banjo player didn't read. But I graduated from that.

Yes, but I think that would be of some interest to other people to know just how you got people like that to work together with different instruments? Did you teach some things by rote or was it clearly an ear ...
